name: customerName
description: Customer display name

name: invoiceCode
description: Invoice reference code (e.g., INV-000101)

name: invoiceTitle
description: Invoice title

name: paymentAmount
description: Payment amount with currency (e.g., USD 1,500.00)

name: paymentDate
description: Date payment was made (e.g., April 10, 2026)

name: paymentMethod
description: Payment method used (e.g., Bank Transfer, Credit Card)

name: paymentReference
description: Payment reference or transaction ID

name: grandTotal
description: Invoice grand total with currency (e.g., USD 3,500.00)

name: totalPaid
description: Total amount paid so far (e.g., USD 2,000.00)

name: balanceRemaining
description: Remaining balance (e.g., USD 1,500.00)

name: paymentStatus
description: Current invoice payment status (e.g., Partially Paid, Paid)

name: safariName
description: Safari name

name: safariCode
description: Safari code

name: paymentNotes
description: Notes about this payment

name: isCrossCurrency
description: Whether this is a cross-currency payment (true/false)

name: exchangeRate
description: Exchange rate applied (e.g., 1.08). Only present for cross-currency payments.

name: invoiceCurrency
description: The invoice currency the payment settles (e.g., USD). Only present for cross-currency payments.

name: paymentCurrency
description: Currency the payment was made in (e.g., EUR)

name: equivalentAmount
description: Equivalent amount in invoice currency after conversion (e.g., USD 7,560.00). Only present for cross-currency payments.

name: bankAccountName
description: Name of the bank account the payment was deposited to

name: sentDate
description: Date the receipt email was sent (e.g., April 10, 2026)

name: companyEmail
description: Company contact email address
